panels.title: Quarantine Health — is the live demo actually up?

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM heartbeats WHERE bot_id LIKE '${env}-%' AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 90000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM heartbeats WHERE bot_id LIKE '${env}-%'
SELECT COALESCE(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - MAX(ts))/1000.0, 999999) AS v FROM heartbeats WHERE bot_id LIKE '${env}-%'
SELECT COALESCE(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - MAX(ts))/60000.0, 999999) AS v FROM candles WHERE env = '${env}'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM events WHERE env = '${env}' AND category='connection' AND level IN ('WARN','ERROR','CRITICAL') AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NULL

panels.title: Order Flow — real matching engine (rejections/latency a sim never sees)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND entry_ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM events WHERE env = '${env}' AND category='order' AND level IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM signals WHERE env = '${env}' AND outcome='rejected' AND ts >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())*1000)::BIGINT - 86400000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND close_reason='liquidated'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(hold_candles),1) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS time, bot_id, level, category, message FROM events WHERE env = '${env}' AND category IN ('order','position','connection') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT 100 + COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0*SUM((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int)/COUNT(*) END AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt>0)/NULLIF(-SUM(pnl_net_usdt) FILTER (WHERE pnl_net_usdt<=0),0),0) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),0) AS v FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

SELECT to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS "time", 100 + SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS equity FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY exit_ts

SELECT bot_id, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS net_usdt, ROUND(AVG((CASE WHEN direction='long' THEN exit_price-entry_price ELSE entry_price-exit_price END)/NULLIF(ABS(entry_price-sl_price),0)),2) AS avg_r FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bot_id ORDER BY net_usdt DESC

panels.title: Fill Realism vs Model — §18 sim-vs-real (target < 15% deviation)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.entry_price - c.close) ELSE (c.close - t.entry_price) END) / NULLIF(c.close,0) * 100),4) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.entry_price - c.close) ELSE (c.close - t.entry_price) END) / NULLIF(c.close,0) * 100))/0.05, 2) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.entry_price - c.close) ELSE (c.close - t.entry_price) END) / NULLIF(c.close,0) * 100)),4) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND c.close IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.entry_price - c.close) ELSE (c.close - t.entry_price) END) / NULLIF(c.close,0) * 100, 4) AS slippage_pct FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT to_timestamp(t.entry_ts/1000.0) AS "time", (CASE WHEN t.direction='long' THEN (t.entry_price - c.close) ELSE (c.close - t.entry_price) END) / NULLIF(c.close,0) * 100 AS slippage_pct FROM trades t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT close FROM candles WHERE pair=t.pair AND timeframe=t.timeframe AND env=t.env AND ts <= t.entry_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE t.env='${env}' AND t.exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND to_timestamp(t.entry_ts/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY t.entry_ts

panels.title: Labs ↔ Phase cross-check — does the demo venue match the sim?

targets.rawSql: SELECT pair, split_part(bot_id,'-',4) AS strategy, env, COUNT(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS expectancy, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt),4) AS net_usdt FROM trades WHERE env IN ('dev', '${env}') AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pair, strategy, env ORDER BY pair, strategy, env

SELECT to_timestamp(entry_ts/1000.0) AS entry, bot_id, pair, direction, ROUND(entry_price::numeric,6) AS entry_px, ROUND(exit_price::numeric,6) AS exit_px, close_reason, ROUND(pnl_net_usdt,4) AS net_usdt, hold_candles FROM trades WHERE env = '${env}' ORDER BY entry_ts DESC LIMIT 30
